title: Automate the IBKR gateway /tickle session keep-alive
description: docs/architecture/Backend.md documents keeping the gateway session alive with a periodic GET /tickle call roughly once a minute, but this is currently a manual step for whoever does the browser login -- nothing in IBKRProvider or the FastAPI app itself ever calls it, so an authenticated session will silently expire on its own. Add a background repeating task that calls /tickle on an interval, only when Settings.ibkr_enabled is True. Depends on backend-ibkr-status-endpoint landing first so there's a way to observe/verify the keep-alive is actually working.

checklist.step: Add a tickle() method to IBKRProvider calling GET /tickle, following the same _request boundary/error-handling convention as its other methods.
Add a FastAPI lifespan background task that calls tickle() on an interval, started only when Settings.ibkr_enabled is True, and cleanly cancelled/stopped on app shutdown.
Decide and record the polling interval (docs/architecture/Backend.md says 'roughly once a minute' -- pick and justify a concrete value).
Unit tests for the tickle() call itself, and for the lifespan task being a no-op when ibkr_enabled is False.
